description: This class implements a business step for adding periodic accrual entries to a loan during the cash flow processing (COB). It utilizes services for loan accrual processing, handles exceptions, and logs processing steps.

classes.name: AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesBusinessStep
classes.description: A Spring component implementing a business step to add periodic accrual entries to a loan.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the accrual addition process for a given loan, handling exceptions and logging.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the enum style name identifying the business step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the business step.
